**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Mr Innes](../persons.html#744)Miss Robertson’s two papers Home Daughters and Power are quite safe, only there has not been room for them yet.[^1] Does she want them back?
I find I cannot get Plataea into the Christmas number, it must come in a regular one. I sent off the bill of fare for the Xmas no yesterday.

The first story is Friday’s Child, which I think would afford the best illustration.

The little boy listening to the old sailor-gardener’s stories would I think be best - To have him sitting in the wood with the dead dog would be too sad, or too like last year’s picture

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Neither of Miss Robertson\'s articles, nor \'Plataea\' seem to have been published in MP.
